description: View profiling history and performance trends for a store. Shows how render times have changed over time. Every profiling call is automatically saved to history. Use this to track the impact of optimizations.

clearHistory.description: Set to true to clear history for this store/page.

limit.description: Maximum number of history entries to return (default: 10)

pagePath.description: Filter history to a specific page path. If omitted, lists all profiled pages.

name: get_profile_history
